description: This pie chart illustrates the proportional distribution of various biomedical named entity categories, contextualized by a study on biomedical named entity recognition. The chart consists of 26 distinct slices arranged visually in a counter-clockwise descending order of size, starting from the 12 o'clock position. The chart does not include a separate legend; rather, category text labels are placed outside the chart adjacent to their corresponding segments, with numerical percentage values written directly inside the slices. The categories and their annotated proportions are as follows: Chemical (blue, 32%), Protein (orange, 15%), DNA (green, 6%), Chemical Family (red, 5%), Disease (purple, 5%), Cell Type (brown, 5%), Drug (pink, 4%), Frequency (grey, 3%), Cell Line (yellow, 3%), Dosage (cyan, 3%), Strength (blue, 3%), Gene Or Gene Product (orange, 2%), Form (green, 2%), Disease Or Phenotypic Feature (red, 2%), Specific Disease (purple, 2%), Reason (brown, 2%), Route (pink, 1%), Chemical Entity (grey, 1%), Sequence Variant (yellow, 1%), Modifier (cyan, 1%), RNA (blue, 1%), Disease Class (orange, 1%), and Organism Taxon (green, 1%). The final three visible slices—ADE (red), Duration (purple), and Composite Mention (brown)—are each labeled as 0%. There are no visually emphasized features, such as exploded, offset, or bolded slices, within the chart.
